t: This is 111 and 115 Maze Hill in Greenwich, a building that was home to two architects. Gordon Bowyer, born in 1923, worked for more than four decades in postwar modernism, on projects from private houses to commercial interiors and public galleries. Ursula Bowyer, born in Germany in 1925, became known for interiors and kitchens that mixed Bauhaus-influenced modernism with a strong sense of how a home works. Both were also significant collectors of modern British art. Gordon lived here until his death in 2019, and Ursula lived and died here in 2025.
